caption: The drawing depicts a single metal teapot with a tall, cylindrical body, a rounded base, a curved spout on the left, and an ornate, looping handle on the right. The teapot features a domed lid with a decorative finial on top and a beaded edge around its rim. The metallic surface of the teapot reflects various shades of gray with subtle areas of yellow and orange highlights, suggesting reflections and possibly tarnish. The drawing is rendered on a plain, off-white or beige background with no additional objects or decorative elements. The artist's name, "DANA BARTLETT," is visible in small text at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Pewter Coffee Pot
